description: Caddy HTTP server monitoring with filtering by host

panels.description: The number of requests currently being handled by the server.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(value) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_requests_in_flight' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ServiceName)

panels.title: Requests in flight

panels.description: Total requests handled in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_requests_total' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime

panels.title: Total requests

panels.description: Rate of requests handled per second in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta)/greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime),1) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_requests_total' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime

panels.title: Requests per second

panels.description: Median round-trip request duration for the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (SELECT bound, sum(n) OVER (ORDER BY bound) AS cum FROM (SELECT if(i <= length(ExplicitBounds), ExplicitBounds[i], inf) AS bound, sum(counts[i]) AS n FROM (SELECT ExplicitBounds, sumForEach(delta) AS counts FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ExplicitBounds, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), arrayMap((a,b) -> if(a >= b, a-b, a), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_request_duration_seconds' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime GROUP BY ExplicitBounds) ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(counts) AS i GROUP BY bound))

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['method'] AS series, delta FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, toFloat64(Count) - lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(Count)) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, toFloat64(Count), raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_request_duration_seconds' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix))) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Request duration percentiles over the preceding five minutes. Per-series histogram deltas are summed as arrays before expanding bounds; the latest sample is shown in each display interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, '0.99' AS series, argMax(value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.99)(if(i <= length(ExplicitBounds), ExplicitBounds[i], inf), cumulative_counts[i]) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ExplicitBounds, arrayCumSum(sumForEach(counts) OVER (PARTITION BY ExplicitBounds ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp64Milli(TimeUnix) RANGE BETWEEN 299999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cumulative_counts FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ExplicitBounds, sumForEach(delta) AS counts FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ExplicitBounds, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), arrayMap((a,b) -> if(a >= b, a-b, a), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_request_duration_seconds' AND ServiceName='caddy' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix)) GROUP BY TimeUnix, ExplicitBounds)) ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(cumulative_counts) AS i WHERE TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Request duration percentiles

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'request' AS series, delta FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, Sum - lagInFrame(Sum, 1, Sum) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Sum, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='caddy_http_request_size_bytes' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${job:singlequote}), $job) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${instance:singlequote}), $instance) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host'] IN (${host:singlequote}), $host) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix))) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
